verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a SaaS product with AI features (Fibi agent, AI answers, AI insights), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no documented control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The Training Data API is a different feature: it supplies knowledge to the support agent rather than providing an opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
